The category links still use `/catalog?category=...`. They now request a per-link prefetch, and the product lookup is cached by category. That lets Next.js prepare each URL’s heading and products before the click, so a completed prefetch can navigate without showing “Loading category…” or waiting for a full server render.

The production build passed. I also checked both category URLs: each per-link prefetch contained the correct heading and products.
